parameters.content:
## STEP 1: Preprocessing
Pre-split single-page PDFs loaded as base64.
Production: Egnyte/SharePoint intake → Marker API splits PDF → individual pages queued for processing

## STEPS 2-5: Per-Page Processing Loop
Scout scores complexity → Router branches → Describer (complex) or Extractor (simple) converts → Verifier quality-checks against source → loop to next page

### Complex Path (Describer)
Vision-based analysis for charts, tables, visuals.
Outputs: key conclusion, visual description,
extracted data points, source attribution

### Simple/Moderate Path (Extractor)
Direct text extraction. Preserves structure,
tables, and bullet points verbatim.
Faster, lower token cost.

## STEPS 6-7: Assembly → RAG Handoff
Stitches pages into structured markdown with YAML frontmatter
and quality scorecard. Hands off to RAG ingestion pipeline
for chunking, embedding, and vector store upsert.
